estilo: Gibby: 3D estilizado tipo película animada, con la paleta de ABASTO (lima, bosque y ámbar). Todas son objetos recortados para que sobresalgan de las tarjetas. El texto del estilo está en scripts/ilustraciones/generar.mjs.

imagenes.tema: A cheerful baker woman in a forest-green apron and a white baker cap proudly holding a big wooden tray full of golden-brown Bolivian saltenas (oval baked empanadas with a braided seam on top), with a white flour sack, a few eggs and a wooden rolling pin next to her. Three-quarter view, warm and appetizing. No purple, pink or magenta anywhere. Floating in the air with nothing under it, big and filling most of the frame. Absolutely no floor, no ground plane, no shadow under the objects.

A tiny charming neighborhood corner store as a floating diorama: a forest-green and lime striped awning, a wooden counter with candy jars and a little cash box, shelves packed with rice sacks, golden oil bottles and colorful soda bottles; a friendly shopkeeper man in a forest-green polo behind the counter, smiling and waving. No purple, pink or magenta anywhere. Floating in the air with nothing under it, big and filling most of the frame. Absolutely no floor, no ground plane, no shadow under the objects.
